The sale of beer having recently been legalized upon the payment of a license fee to the State and municipality, the occupation or license ordinance is hereby amended so as to include the sale of beer within the corporate limits of the Town of Chipley, as follows:

Wholesale dealers $25.00 per annum Retail dealers 10.00 " " i

All license to terminate December 3ist each year

The Mayor and Council reserve the right to revoke the license of any dealer at any time his or her place should become a nuisance.

Ail persons firms or corporations desiring to engage in the sale of beer, wholesale or retail shell made application to the Town Recorder for a license or permit to conduct said business at the time or hefore engaging in same.

Be it further ordained that any person, firm or corporation engaging in the wholesale or retail sale of beer within said Town without first securing a license or permit to conduct said business shall be deemed guilty of disorderly conduct and upon conviction of said offense shall be fined not exceeding thirty days or both in the discretion of the court.

Read twice and adopted a5 an emergency act this the 17th day of June 1935S in regular meeting.

JW Caldwell, Mayor

J W Colley, Recorder eed
